summary: First E2E test of LoNo MVP. Backend: 25/26 pytest passing (96%). Fixed 1 ObjectId serialization bug in /api/creator/dashboard. Frontend: Home, Signup, Login, Wallet (balance 100 shown, transactions signup_bonus row visible), Governance (vote works, double-vote blocked with toast 'Already voted on this proposal'), Watch page all load. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge, z-index 9999) overlaps and intercepts pointer events on AI Chat FAB (data-testid=ai-chat-fab, z-index 40) at bottom-right corner. Users cannot open AI chat with a normal click. Also BLOCKER: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded ('Max budget: 0.001') so /api/ai/chat returns 500. AI summarize succeeded once but ai/chat consistently fails.

critical.issue: 500 - litellm.BadRequestError: Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.002142, Max budget: 0.001. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY quota exhausted.

minor.issue: Returns 500 with Stripe AuthenticationError because STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' is invalid. Need a real test key to verify checkout URL returned.

ui_bugs.issue: The Emergent 'Made with Emergent' badge (#emergent-badge, z-index 9999) sits at bottom-right and overlaps the AI Chat FAB (z-index 40). Pointer events are intercepted so real users cannot click the FAB. Confirmed via getBoundingClientRect overlap=true and z-index comparison. Fix: increase FAB z-index above 9999 (e.g. z-[10000]) OR shift FAB position (e.g. bottom-24 to sit above the badge).

integration_issues.issue: Depends on /api/ai/chat which is 500 due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded; even when FAB force-opened, sending message shows fallback 'Sorry, I'm having trouble right now.'

action_items: URGENT: Refresh/replace EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - current key has max budget $0.001 which is exceeded, blocking /api/ai/chat.
Fix z-index/positioning conflict between AI Chat FAB and Emergent badge. Suggest: className='fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-[10000]' or move FAB to bottom-left.
Provide a valid Stripe test key (currently sk_test_emergent placeholder is rejected by Stripe API).
Optional: expose better error surfacing when AI/chat returns 500 (currently shown as generic fallback message).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py creator_dashboard: FIXED - was returning raw Mongo doc with injected _id (ObjectId) after insert_one; now pops _id. Same pattern should be reviewed in other insert-and-return endpoints (creator_upload already pops).
server.py stake endpoint: stake_doc is inserted by insert_one which injects _id; response pops _id (good).
server.py: seed_if_empty may leave stale _id in memory but not returned to user - OK.
Frontend: AIChatFloat FAB uses z-40 while Emergent badge is z-9999 → z-index conflict.
server.py content watch endpoint gives 1 LONO/min capped at 10 per event but request in problem statement said 300s=5 LONO reward → matches (implemented correctly).

success_rate.backend: 96% (25/26 pytest; only /api/ai/chat failing due to LLM key budget)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all core pages/flows work; AI chat blocked by badge overlap + LLM budget)

AI chat test currently fails - main agent must obtain/rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY before this can pass. rca of the issue: AI Chat FAB overlap: #emergent-badge (external injected badge, z:9999, position:fixed bottom-right) has higher stacking than AIChatFloat FAB (z:40) both at the same anchor. Real click reaches badge, opens external link. Force-click bypasses in tests but real users cannot open the chat. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/AIChatFloat.jsx: change 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40' to 'fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-[10000]' (or similar).
